subjects.desc: Joy (a small girl elf: red pointed elf hat with a plain red band, two long brown braids, pointed ears, white shirt under a red vest with white trim, white shorts, red-and-green striped stockings, red curled shoes)

shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.
shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Joy stands in the snow near the frozen lake with her right arm stretched out, pointing at the round hole in the ice. She bends her knees a little, covers a giggle with her left hand for a moment, then says her line with a mischievous smile, jabbing the pointing finger toward the hole twice on the words ice shower. Her braids swing as she laughs. After the line her lips close, she lowers her arm and hugs herself, shivering playfully as if she feels the cold.

dialogue.line: He takes an ice shower at nine thirty.
